title: Naveen Kumar and Shobit Gupta
body: Event Name Codebase Evaluation & Discovery | LH2 AI Labs Hi, thanks for booking time with the LH2 AI Labs Data Partnerships team. The purpose of this call is to determine if your dormant, pre-2024 software projects qualify for our AI training data acquisition pipeline, and to outline the commercial payout structure. What we will cover in our 15-20 minutes: 1. Asset Discovery: We will ask a few quick questions regarding the history, tech stack, and IP ownership of your dormant projects (we only acquire code where you fully retain the IP, with no active client NDAs). 2. The Evaluation Process: We will walk you through our technical valuation process. 3. Commercial Structuring: An overview of our acquisition models. How to prepare: Please come with a rough estimate of how many dormant, non-public projects you currently hold, estimates lines of codes, PRs, commits etc., and confirmation that your team was the original author.
